name: Plan comparison
prompt: Compare plans: MRR and seats by plan, plan KPIs, and a per-plan detail table.

binding.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(mrr),0) AS mrr FROM mrr_by_plan
SELECT SUM(accounts) AS accounts FROM mrr_by_plan
SELECT ROUND(SUM(mrr)/NULLIF(SUM(accounts),0),0) AS avg_mrr FROM mrr_by_plan
SELECT plan AS plan, ROUND(mrr,0) AS mrr FROM mrr_by_plan ORDER BY mrr DESC

copy.title: MRR by plan
copy.caption: Starter narrowly leads MRR; the four plans are within $4K of each other.

binding.sql: SELECT plan AS plan, seats AS seats FROM mrr_by_plan ORDER BY seats DESC

copy.title: Seats by plan
copy.caption: Seat counts are similarly balanced — each plan carries roughly 13K seats.

binding.sql: SELECT plan AS plan, accounts AS accounts, seats AS seats, ROUND(mrr,0) AS mrr, ROUND(avg_mrr,0) AS avg_mrr FROM mrr_by_plan ORDER BY mrr DESC

copy.title: Plan detail
copy.caption: Accounts, seats, MRR and average MRR for every plan.
